name: Tabs: Warm Keynote
description: Chapter head and lede, then a glass card holding a few tabs, each with its own panel (a list, a table or a paragraph); clicking a tab during playback switches, static rendering shows only the first. Three separate slides would lose the comparison of switching inside the same frame.

kicker.hint: chapter label, e.g. "01 — Why"; numbered automatically by the scaffold when the slides in the story carry a chapter, otherwise left empty (an empty label takes the vertical bar with it)

meta.hint: pill tag top right: audience, phase or occasion, up to 10 characters, filled automatically from the first clause of occasion; leave empty when not needed

title.hint: the claim of the slide in one sentence, up to 2 lines and 24 characters; *keyword* marks an emphasis

subtitle.hint: a one-line lede, up to 50 characters

panels.hint: 2 to 5 tabs, labels up to 6 characters; a panel holds 3 to 5 items or a small table; the first panel is what static rendering and QA see

title.value: One page, three readers, each with their own section

subtitle.value: leads write the progress, owners answer the blockers, everyone reads the decisions.

items: Write: three lines per thread, numbers first
Review: read the other leads before Friday noon
Decide: mark what still needs a call
Answer only the blockers with your name on them
One line: what unblocks it, and by when
Silence counts as agreement by Monday

caption.value: Click a tab during playback; static mode shows only the first panel.
